towns.name: New Benalia
innkeeper: Welcome to New Benalia, mage. The capital rests easier with your kind about.
board: The five color-wells of the Domains are held by guardians. Earn each well's attunement.
When all five are yours, the Phyrexian Portal in the desolate waste will open. So say the seers.
The mage towers' waystones carry those who beat their mages from tower to tower.
The arena opens soon. Practise your duelling.

folk.name: Benalish herald
text: Every road in Aerona leads to New Benalia. Most of them come back.

folk.name: Town crier
text: Hear ye! Phyrexian stragglers in every Domain! Arm yourselves with cards!

folk.name: Merchant
text: More vendors here than anywhere in the Domains, and a shop of wares from other planes.

folk.name: Old soldier
text: Past the Hurloons the wilds turn hard. The waymarkers say how hard.

folk.name: Caravan master
text: The planeswalkers' caravans come and go. Watch the market square.

towns.guild: The Order of the White Shield

towns.name: Capashen Hold
innkeeper: Welcome to Capashen Hold, mage. Rest here, and here you wake if a duel goes badly.
board: Bounty: Phyrexian scouts in the Benalish Farmlands.
Wanted: an escort to the Fallen Keep.

folk.name: Benalish squire
text: The Capashens held this land before New Benalia stood.

folk.name: Old pilgrim
text: Serra's angels guard the fallen keep still, but not for her.

towns.name: The Elfhames of Llanowar
innkeeper: Welcome to the elfhames. The trees are listening; tip accordingly.
board: Bounty: the wurm eating the north orchard.
The Steel Leaf ride at dawn. Stay off the trails.

folk.name: Elvish ranger
text: Across the Suder the forest begins, and it does not end politely.

folk.name: Wurm herder
text: They're gentle, really. Just very, very large.

towns.name: The Vess Estate
innkeeper: Welcome to the Vess estate's village. The lady of the house is... away.
board: Bounty: bog-wraiths on the Morass road.
Do not wander into the Vess crypts. Do not.

folk.name: Gravedigger
text: The Morass was a forest once. The trees remember.

folk.name: Cabal defector
text: The Cabal made this swamp. I helped. I'm sorry.

towns.name: Keld
innkeeper: Welcome to Keld. Sit, drink, and if someone shouts, shout back.
board: Bounty: the ice giants raiding the north herds.
The Skyshroud is not for the soft.

folk.name: Keldon warrior
text: Fight me. No? Then fight the giants, they're asking for it.

folk.name: Skald
text: Past the waste lie the Domains. Past Parma lies nothing.

towns.name: Tolarian Academy
innkeeper: Welcome to the Academy on Walassa. Mind the time rifts on your way to bed.
board: Lost: one automaton, answers to nothing.
Research assistants wanted for the tower. Hazard pay.

folk.name: Lecturer
text: We rebuilt the Academy on Walassa. The old one is best not spoken of.

folk.name: Fisher
text: The causeway floods at high tide. Walk quickly.

towns.name: Serra's Rest
board: Ferry to Verdura at the south dock.

folk.name: Shepherd
text: The angels used to bless the flocks. Now they take them.

innkeeper: The Feather and Lance. Small, but the beds are dry.

towns.name: Steelleaf Glade
board: The ferry to Shanodin sails from the east shore.

folk.name: Old druid
text: Past the glade the forest is older than the elves, and less forgiving.

innkeeper: The Iron Acorn. Small, but the beds are dry.

towns.name: Cabal Crossing
board: Cultists seen in the Drowned Wood. They wave.

folk.name: Lantern keeper
text: Keep the lantern lit and the dead keep their distance. Usually.

innkeeper: The Rotten Plank. Small, but the beds are dry.

towns.name: Keldon Watch
board: The ferry to Foriys sails from the south shore.

folk.name: Lookout
text: From up here you can see the waste smoking. The Portal is out there.

innkeeper: The Axe and Ember. Small, but the beds are dry.

towns.name: Denawa
board: Tutors wanted. Must not be phased out.

folk.name: Scribe
text: Denawa copies what Walassa forgets.

innkeeper: The Scholar's Rest. Small, but the beds are dry.

towns.name: Avenant
board: Archers wanted for the Hurloon passes.

folk.name: Archer
text: Avenant's arrows fly true. Avenant's ale, less so.

innkeeper: The Bent Bow. Small, but the beds are dry.

towns.name: Sursi
board: The ferry to Stahaan sails from the west cliffs. The minotaurs do not welcome visitors.

folk.name: Pegasus groom
text: The herds fly the cliffs at dusk. Don't stand under them.

innkeeper: The Winged Mare. Small, but the beds are dry.

towns.name: Foriys
board: The ferry to Keld sails from the north shore.

folk.name: Giant's herald
text: The giants argue with themselves. Both heads usually lose.

innkeeper: The Two Heads. Small, but the beds are dry.

towns.name: Oneah
board: Do not go south into Amjad.

folk.name: Oneahn elder
text: Oneah is small, and means to stay that way.

innkeeper: The Quiet Oak. Small, but the beds are dry.

towns.name: Verdura Grove
board: The druids ask that you leave the wood as you found it.

folk.name: Druid
text: Verdura grows back faster than you can cut it.

innkeeper: The Green Cup. Small, but the beds are dry.
